profile.headline: TS/SCI Technical Program Manager | Enterprise Solutions Architect | Driving Multi-Million Dollar AI & Cloud Modernization Initiatives
profile.jobTitle: Principal Technical Advisor & Acting Technical Program Manager
profile.summary:
As a TS/SCI-cleared Technical Program Manager and Enterprise Solutions Architect, I operate in the critical space where complex engineering execution meets high-level strategic outcomes. For over 14 years, I have navigated the intersection of Department of Defense (DoD) operations, enterprise cloud architecture, and cross-functional team leadership to modernize mission-critical defense infrastructure.

My focus is on scaling engineering capabilities and transforming legacy systems into highly secure, automated DevSecOps environments. Most recently, I architected and successfully pitched an enterprise generative AI strategy  that eliminated $4.4M in projected hardware costs by engineering localized data caching methodologies.

I thrive on bypassing bureaucratic bottlenecks and translating deep technical architecture into clear, actionable ROI for C-suite executives and military commanders through a mixture of software development experience and clear communication skills that bridge the gap between coders and the people that make the decisions that guide their work. Whether I am directing agile workflows for developer squads, managing complex DoD acquisition requests, or negotiating delivery timelines directly with Chief Engineering stakeholders, my raison d'être is demystifying the gap between developers and the decision makers driving the visions they bring to life.

Core Expertise: Technical Program Management (TPM) | Enterprise Cloud Architecture (AWS/Azure) | DevSecOps & CI/CD | Generative AI Integration | Cross-Functional Leadership | Defense Acquisitions & Compliance
I am currently open to remote operational leadership, Senior TPM, or Principal Architect opportunities within the cleared public sector and defense technology space.

positions.title: Principal Technical Advisor & Acting Technical Program Manager
positions.description:
Directing end-to-end technical program management and enterprise architecture within highly secure DoW DevSecOps environments. Operating as the strategic bridge between complex engineering execution and executive outcomes, I lead cross-functional teams to modernize mission-critical defense applications and infrastructure.

Key Impacts & Initiatives:

Strategic Revenue Growth: Architected and pitched an enterprise generative AI integration to military and executive stakeholders, securing a 200% contract expansion.

Enterprise Cost Reductions: Identified and eliminated $4.4M in projected hardware expenditures by engineering localized data caching methodologies and containerized architectures.

Operational Efficiency: Compressed delivery timelines by 66% by streamlining complex DoD acquisition pipelines and negotiating directly with Chief Engineering stakeholders.

Program & Personnel Ownership: Manage cross-functional software engineering teams to modernize and scale high-priority capabilities (including Navy recruiting applications) utilizing .NET Core, Java, React, Postgres, AWS, and Azure.

Compliance & Security: Formulate and implement secure DoD DevSecOps practices, embedding automated vulnerability remediation (Fortify/SonarQube) directly into CI/CD YAML pipelines to resolve critical STIGs and retain functional network security authority.

Administrative Oversight: Formally stepped in to cover project management absences, overseeing budget alignments, complex acquisition requests, and TS/SCI clearance documentation.

Skills: Technical Program Management (TPM) · Enterprise Architecture · Generative AI · Cross-Functional Team Leadership · DevSecOps · Agile/SAFe Frameworks · Cloud Computing

positions.title: Software Development Security Analyst
positions.description: Experienced Software Development Security Analyst skilled in integrating security into the software development lifecycle. Proven ability to conduct vulnerability assessments, implement secure coding practices, and collaborate with development teams to meet security standards. Adept in threat modeling, risk analysis, and recommending proactive security measures to protect applications and data.
positions.insights: Product Requirements, Technical Engineering and +24 skills

positions.title: Software Security Analyst
positions.description:
Strategic  Technical  Liaison: Served  as  the  primary  bridge  between  security  and  software  teams, communicating complex vulnerabilities and deployment readiness.
Security  Architecture: Developed  and  engineered  an  automated  security  matrix  reporting  service utilizing the Zimperium API framework.
Release Management: Supported major software releases, upgrades, and secure deployment activities utilizing ASP.NET, Entity Framework, Azure, SQL, and robust testing protocols (Cypress, Postman).

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: As a Senior Web Developer, I specialize in building and maintaining high-performance websites and web applications. I’m skilled in both front-end and back-end technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and Node.js, and have experience with databases such as MySQL and MongoDB. I enjoy leading development teams, collaborating with different departments, and delivering solutions that improve user experience and meet business goals. I’m passionate about optimizing performance, troubleshooting challenges, and ensuring everything runs smoothly from start to finish. In the vein of leadership, I lead and trained the newest developers assigned to the unit, ushering them to the next step in their careers, and managing individual projects between training courses.
positions.insights: User Experience (UX), Application Programming Interfaces (API) and +19 skills

positions.title: SENIOR WEB DEVELOPER/TRAINER
positions.description: Supervised 4 - member Database Modernization Team, modernizing legacy applications with 100% information fidelity enveloping 50 years of archived data. I designed and developed web applications and services to support cyber operations, nuclear deterrence, and expenditure management while utilizing ASP.NET with entity framework and MVC and building out custom relational databases to handle complex relationships between data objects. I developed web services to log and track orbiting bodies from equipment aboard ocean-based assets, and created web applications for sortie data entry and processing.  I engineered a multi-organization task management application, enabling task tracking for decision makers and providing crucial information for strategic planning.
positions.insights: Software Project Management, Engineering Management and +30 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skilled Software Developer with a solid background in designing, developing, and optimizing web and desktop applications. Proficient in languages and frameworks such as .NET, JavaScript, SQL, and MVC, with a focus on creating scalable, user-friendly solutions. Known for problem-solving, improving application performance, and collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver projects on time and within scope.
positions.insights: Product Requirements, Technical Engineering and +27 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Software Engineer, I specialize in building and improving applications with a focus on clean, efficient code. I’m skilled in languages like Java, Python, and .NET, and have experience throughout the software development lifecycle—from design and testing to deployment. I enjoy tackling complex problems and working closely with teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet both user needs and business goals.
